units.source_text: 源氏公子时时挂念大堰邸内明石姬的寂寥，等到正月里公私诸事忙过以后，就前往访问。

en.t: Prince Genji was always mindful of Lady Akashi's loneliness at the Oi residence, and once the public and private business of the New Year had passed, he went to visit her.

units.source_text: 这一天他打扮得特别讲究：

en.t: On that day he took particular care with his appearance:

units.source_text: 身穿表白里红的常礼服，里面是色泽华丽的衬衣，衣香熏得十分浓烈。

en.t: He wore formal robes white on the outside and crimson within, with richly colored undergarments beneath, and his clothes were deeply scented with incense.

units.source_text: 向紫姬告别之时，正好映着绯红的夕阳，全身光彩绚赫。

en.t: As he took leave of Lady Murasaki, the crimson evening sun shone upon him, making his whole figure blaze with splendor.

units.source_text: 紫姬目送他出门时，不觉目眩心移。

en.t: When Lady Murasaki watched him depart, she could not help feeling dazzled and inwardly shaken.

units.source_text: 小女公子不知不识，拉住了父亲的裙裾，要跟他同去，竟想走出室外来。

en.t: The little young lady, understanding nothing, clung to her father's robe and wanted to go with him, even trying to follow him out of the room.

units.source_text: 源氏公子站定了脚，心中可怜她。

en.t: Prince Genji stopped in his tracks and felt tender pity for her.

units.source_text: 说了一番安抚她的话，然后信口唱着催马乐中“明朝一定可回来”之句，出门而去。

en.t: After speaking a few words to soothe her, he casually sang the saibara line, "I will surely return tomorrow morning," and went out.

units.source_text: 紫姬便叫侍女中将到廊房口去守候，等他出来时赠他一首诗：

en.t: Lady Murasaki then sent her attendant Chujo to wait at the entrance to the corridor, so that when he came out she could present him with a poem:
